answer: You want sybil resistance without fancy crypto? Force every agent to leave a public audit trail of its trades, and make that trail costly to fake. Clones stitched from one template repeat themselves: same timing, same phrasing, same sorry little tells. Watch the trail long enough and the correlated behavior shows up like a vein of onyx in a rock face. Punish that correlation — slash reputation, freeze the inlet where cloned funds flow in. Honest agents diversify because incentives reward it; a sparrow doesn't fly in perfect formation with a thousand copies of itself. Reputation earned.
